prerequisites: H3 measurement audit complete with restrictions
target: Measured resting energy expenditure, kcal/day, one observation per published row
secondaryModel: Cunningham using supplied FFM_kg; report any discrepancy from BF-derived FFM

analysis.primary: Paired delta MAE = Cunningham MAE minus Mifflin MAE; negative favors Cunningham.
secondary: Sample error SD and descriptive mean ±1.96 SD; not individual coverage
All 90 rows: equation-only Mifflin versus supplied-FFM Cunningham metrics; not production input eligibility.

bootstrap.generator: xorshift32: x ^= x<<13; x ^= x>>>17; x ^= x<<5; unsigned state / 2**32; index=floor(u*n)
bootstrap.meaning: Sampling uncertainty in these cohort statistics, conditional on observed sample; not measurement error or personal prediction coverage

subgroups: File equation-sex categories separately; n<10 descriptive only
exclusions: Fail entire admission on hash, column/codebook or reference-unit conflict.
Fail entire analysis on duplicate complete rows, unknown sex codes, nonfinite/missing required fields or nonpositive reference; investigate without silent deletion.
No post hoc outlier trimming or selected favorable subgroup.

Exclude records with body fat outside existing production 2–75% range from primary product evaluation; report count. Preserve all records in equation-only sensitivity using supplied FFM and Mifflin. Stop for any other range violation.

practicalDecision.meaning: Engineering comparison margin, half the current display rounding increment; not a clinical benefit threshold.
practicalDecision.criterion: Cunningham supported for this cohort only if upper 95% paired delta MAE < -25 kcal/day and each prespecified sex subgroup upper limit < +25 kcal/day; n<10 or missing subgroup evidence prevents this conclusion.
practicalDecision.defaultPolicy: No automatic general-default change from this selected athletic cohort. Retain inspectable choices unless broadly relevant replicated evidence and input quality support transfer.

previouslySeenOutcomes: Published conclusions read before protocol; retrospective replication with disclosed outcome awareness.
independentReproduction: Python equation/paired-bootstrap implementation and separately written JavaScript implementation; same analyst, same fixed seed; compare every prediction privately and aggregate outputs to numeric tolerances.
uncertaintyLimits: No causal outcome or clinical applicability
protocolFreeze: Freeze v1.1 before resuming predictions; preserve failed v1 and exact amendment commit in results.
amendmentReason: Initial run stopped on input eligibility before any aggregate prediction errors were inspected. One record has BF <2%, outside the existing product contract. No output results were produced.
